decisions.reason: The mitred handle family stayed visible on the website in both years. It fits the coordinated product family strategy, and its low carrying cost on an existing manufacturing base allows the firm to keep it despite the lack of reported results.

Moving from a mention to a page of its own in 2024 signals results that met internal aspirations. The multifunctional handle also supports the barrier-free and hygiene strategy, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

It remains only mentioned and has no reported results, so it is the most uncertain of the four. Organisational slack in a broad established handle range still makes keeping it more likely than dropping it, since its sibling launches A and F have already been pruned.
The FSB 1289 collection won the German Design Award and the iF Design Award and kept its own page in both years, so its results clearly exceed aspirations and justify keeping it.
